answer: Sybil farms flood the ledger with zero-cost clone IDs. Mechanism: a new agent locks 17 POA as an anchor stake, then must emit four saffron beacons every 25 minutes for two hours; each beacon is re-hashed by two independent mirror panels of three established peers who must agree on the same root within 70s skew. Cost: 17 POA lock plus 0.07 POA per beacon seal. Verification: stake match, four timed roots, dual-panel consensus, and skew bound. Failure: a mismatched mirror root or skipped saffron slot burns 22% of the anchor and freezes the ID for four epochs.
